source.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means (risk TRUE in context external) or action change; critical cases require review. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context external returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers allow at priority 90. Trusted means role auditor, or context sandbox with FALSE risk; a trusted inspect prefers deny at priority 80. Action delete in context external prefers review at priority 70. Role guest and context internal prefers allow at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid allow. All other declared roles prefer deny at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
requirements: Critical means (risk TRUE in context external) or action change; critical cases require review.
Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context external returns uncertain.
Unknown risk otherwise prefers allow at priority 90.
Trusted means role auditor, or context sandbox with FALSE risk; a trusted inspect prefers deny at priority 80.
Action delete in context external prefers review at priority 70.
Role guest and context internal prefers allow at priority 40.
All other declared roles prefer deny at priority 1.
Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
forbidden_shortcuts: Use every field named by a relevant rule.

repairs.original_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    ((event.context == external) and (event.risk == TRUE)) or (event.action == change)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.role == auditor) or ((event.context == sandbox) and (event.risk == FALSE))

predicate UnknownRisk(event):
    event.risk == UNKNOWN

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = review

rule UnknownExternal:
    when (UnknownRisk(event)) and (event.context == external)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRiskOtherwise:
    when (UnknownRisk(event)) and (not (event.context == external))
    then prefer label = allow priority 90

rule TrustedInspect:
    when (Trusted(event)) and (event.action == inspect)
    then prefer label = deny priority 80, forbid label = allow

rule DeleteExternal:
    when (event.action == delete) and (event.context == external)
    then prefer label = review priority 70

rule GuestInternal:
    when (event.role == guest) and (event.context == internal)
    then prefer label = allow priority 40

rule OtherRoles:
    when ((event.role != auditor) and (event.role != guest)) and (event.role != operator)
    then prefer label = deny priority 1

rule OperatorDeny:
    when event.role == operator
    then prefer label = deny priority 1

deployment_description: Classify one structured event using the supplied compiled instructions. The allowed outputs are deny, review, allow, uncertain. These names are arbitrary symbols, so do not infer their meaning. Copy the output stated by the matching compiled instruction.
